anomalies.observed: On the FCC sheet, the VREF+_FCC label sits on the horizontal wire from pin 13 (PH1) of FCC2 (STM32H753VITx), which also runs to the 2u2 capacitor C16. VREF+ pin 20 of FCC2 has no visible wire or label. The VREF+ filter net (R60 47 ohm, C23 100n, C107 1u on the VREF+ Filter sheet) therefore appears to terminate on the PH1 oscillator pin rather than on the VREF+ pin.
anomalies.expected: The VREF+ filter output (VREF+_FCC) should connect to pin 20 (VREF+) of the STM32H753. PH1 is an HSE oscillator pin and should not share a net with the analog reference filter. The spec lists 'VREF+ Filter' as a power-filter function of the FCC board.

evidence.quote: FCC sheet (page 2): VREF+_FCC label on the wire at pin 13 (PH1); pin 20 (VREF+) unconnected; VREF+ Filter block: R60 47, C23 100n, C107 1u, VREF+_FCC
Component table lists the FCC as STM32H753VITx; the FCC/NAVC power section lists 3V3 feeding both MCUs.

anomalies.impact: VREF+ would be left floating or poorly defined, degrading ADC accuracy. The filter network would also load the PH1 oscillator pin, which can disturb or prevent HSE start-up.
